paragraphs.text: Aphelia , also known as Viper Whisperer , is a gorgon assassin from an unknown plane.

Aphelia is a character who debuted in Foundations Jumpstart as part of the Black Snakes deck . She is a light-skinned gorgon assassin who wears a black dress, has green snake hair, and wields a curved dagger. She pairs Gorgons with Snakes as a typal coupling , partially because of their biological link, and partially because 1/1 Gorgons would be unusual sizing.
